[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
David was born before 1755<ref>"Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers, 1740-1900", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X37J-FNN6 : Sat Mar 29 09:11:05 UTC 2025), Entry for David Glascow and Anne Ford, 14 Sep 1773.</ref>

His son [[Glasgow-3592|Thomas]] was born on 1 May 1777 and baptised on 7 May in Rathdowney Catholic parish. The register names David Glascow and [[Ford-28175|Anne Ford]] as his parents.<ref name="Rathdowney1777">Rathdowney Catholic parish register, NLI microfilm 05013/08, image 83, manuscript p.147, Thomas entry near the foot of the right-hand page; [https://registers.nli.ie/pages/vtls000631901_083 National Library of Ireland original scan], inspected 22 October 2026. Born 1 May; baptised 7 May 1777; parents David Glascow and Anne Ford. Household place and sponsors remain unread.</ref>
David married [[Ford-28175|Anne Ford]] at Rathdowney on 14 September 1773.<ref>[https://registers.nli.ie/registers/vtls000631901#page/150/mode/1up Rathdowney Catholic parish register, NLI microfilm 05013/08, image 150, right-hand page, marriage entry dated 14 September 1773].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Rathdowney baptism, reviewed 22 October 2026 ===

This assessment identifies the register child represented by [[Glasgow-3592]] and his expressly named parents. It does not prove that this child became the Tipperary husband of [[Ryan-23770|Johanna Ryan]] or father of [[Glasgow-3595|Michael Glasgow]], and does not identify David with the Scottish [[Glasgow-3456|David Glasgow]]. [[Glasgow-3594|Margaret]]’s separate baptism and the 1773 marriage have not been inspected in this batch. The household townland and sponsors are not securely read from the available low-resolution scan and are not asserted here.

At that review, the next proposed test was to read the 14 September 1773 marriage and Margaret’s July 1774 entry for the household place and witnesses, then test the later Thomas–Johanna–Michael identification against original Tipperary records. David’s own parents remain unknown; his before-1755 birth is an adult-marriage estimate, not a record of his birthplace or age.



Possibly [[Glasgow-3456|David Glasgow (1744-)]]

=== Original Rathdowney marriage — 24 October 2026 ===

The witness line appears to read ‘Michl Grady & Marg Conor’; both abbreviated forenames and the Conor surname reading remain tentative. The register supplies no age, named parents, prior parish, Scottish birthplace or exact townland; the marginal Rathdowney/C. Do notation is not expanded. It does not identify this David with [[Glasgow-3456|David Glasgow]]. Thomas’s 1777 baptism remains the basis for the existing 98% parent assessments, unchanged here. David’s own father remains unknown; his before-1755 birth is an estimate, not a recorded age or birthplace.
